name: Keerai Vadai
steps: Rinse and soak chana dal in the measured water until swollen; drain very well and reserve a small handful whole.
Pulse the remaining dal with chili, ginger and fennel into a coarse crumbly paste, adding no more water.
Mix in dry chopped spinach, onion, curry leaves, reserved dal and salt; squeeze lightly to bind.
Flatten small portions into thin discs and fry in medium-hot oil, turning once the underside has set.
Cook until deep golden, crisp at the rim and no longer damp in the center; drain and serve hot.
tips: Dry the spinach well after washing; excess water makes the lentil vadai heavy and oily.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
